# plot_tercile { #wass2s.plot_tercile }

```python
plot_tercile(A, save_dir=None, colors=None, year=None)
```

Plot a tercile map with categories: Below, Normal, Above.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                                      | Default    |
|--------|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| A      | xarray.DataArray | Data array with tercile categories (0: Below, 1: Normal, 2: Above) and dimensions 'T', 'Y', 'X'. | _required_ |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Uses a custom colormap and displays a legend for tercile categories.
